pages: Cantilever chair has a complete back, blue seat and pedestal. Thin offset underside lines remain; the depth views do not clearly resolve whether tiny seam gaps are cracks.
Chair remains recognizable with blue seat. A narrow diagonal strip/opening appears on the lower left of the rear back panel; isolated or folded status is unclear.
Complete cantilever form and blue seat remain. A conspicuous horizontal opening at the bottom of the back panel exposes blue behind it; seat/back junction also looks separated.
Back, blue seat and pedestal preserved. Thin lines at the front rim and beneath the shell remain; at this scale an accidental crack cannot be separated confidently from the open cantilever structure.
Blue seat and overall cantilever form remain. Diagonal sliver/opening on back panel and interrupted seat/support joins persist after D0.
Body and blue seat retained, but the back-bottom horizontal opening and front seat/support gap remain clearly visible.
Recognizable sled-frame chair, but gray generated seat lies above and largely covers blue C; sections show a substantial vertical mismatch. Open back/seat seams are visible.
Cantilever body uses the blue seat. Several horizontal/diagonal openings divide the back panel, including a wide opening just above the seat; whether loose strips are detached is uncertain.
Blue C serves the seat of a complete cantilever form. Rear back panel has a broad bottom opening and the front rim/seat join is interrupted.
Sled supports and back remain, but gray seat still covers the lower blue C. Gaps remain above and below the back slab; source C is not the visible seating surface.
Blue seat is adopted in a cantilever body. Back panel is much more filled than RAW; a narrow top-edge opening and small front seat/support discontinuity remain.
Blue seat is clearly the seat and body is intact. Back-bottom slot and front support/seat gap remain; sections show an interrupted gray underside.
Blue seat and cantilever support are recognizable. Large wedge-shaped opening at the rounded back crown and side-edge gap break the back surface.
Blue seat, rounded back and pedestal remain. Crown is more filled than baseline, but a narrow triangular gap remains along the upper-left back edge.
Blue seat, rounded back and pedestal form a coherent chair. Back crown appears filled; tiny rim/under-seat discontinuities cannot be decisively classified at this scale.
Blue seat retained. Large back-crown opening and narrow upper side gap persist; cantilever body otherwise complete.
Blue seat retained and crown mostly filled, but an obvious narrow white opening remains on the upper-left back edge.
Rounded back is visually closed and blue seat/support composition remains. Small underside junction interruptions are visible in section, but full-surface crack status remains uncertain.
Complete rounded-back cantilever chair with blue C as seat. No gross loose sheet is visible; fine rim/underside interruptions are too small to classify confidently.
Rounded back, pedestal and blue seat remain coherent. Slight layered edges are visible, but no clear large tear or fragment is apparent.
Blue seat and full cantilever body persist. A small notch/separation at the rounded back crown is visible but its crack status is uncertain at this scale.
Chair body and blue seat are retained. Thin seam lines remain at rim and underside; no clear large missing surface or detached fragment is apparent.
Rounded back and pedestal remain; blue C serves as seat. Fine crown/rim irregularity is visible, without a clearly resolved large crack.
Coherent rounded-back chair and blue seat remain. Small crown notch and fine edge interruptions persist; images do not establish whether these are accidental cracks.
Four-leg chair and blue seat are recognizable. Narrow irregular white openings cross the otherwise filled back panel; fine underside fragments in section cannot establish detached surfaces.
Blue seat and four legs remain, with an open rectangular back window and crossbar. The window can be a valid style; fine ragged edges and underside interruptions leave crack status uncertain.
Coherent four-leg chair with large open back window and blue seat. No gross detached sheet; small ragged rim/underside edges are unresolved.
Filled rounded back, blue seat and four legs are clear. The upper back gaps are largely closed; underside section has interruptions whose extent is uncertain.
Blue seat, legs and a clean open-window back are preserved. The opening has a coherent frame/crossbar and is not counted as a defect; no obvious accidental gap in shown surfaces.
Clean framed open back, four legs and blue seat form a recognizable chair. No clear detached or folded sheet or accidental crack in shown surfaces; hidden topology is unverified.

Four slim legs, thick seat rim and raised rectangular back form a complete chair. Blue C is the seat; the open strip below the back is plausible design, with only tiny unresolved edge discontinuities.
Same complete chair and blue seat. A few thin protruding/loose-looking segments below the left back corner are visible, but their status cannot be resolved at this scale.
Complete slender-leg chair and blue seat retained. No gross detached sheet; minor raw edge discontinuities are too small to certify as cracks.
Blue seat sits on a coherent rim with four legs and a raised framed back. The opening below the back is plausible style; no obvious accidental crack or loose sheet in shown views.
Complete chair and blue seating surface remain. Back-bottom opening is framed and plausible; no obvious residual loose strip or accidental tear is visible.
Coherent slender-leg chair, blue seat and raised back preserved. No obvious detached sheet or crack; depth-hidden contacts remain unverified.
Raised rectangular back, four slim legs and blue seat form a complete chair. Tiny rim-side breaks appear in sections; no obvious gross fragment.
Blue seat and chair structure are preserved. A thin line below the back and minor rim discontinuities are visible, too small to establish a detached sheet or true crack.
Full chair and blue seat retained; slight ragged edges in RAW remain. No obvious large missing region or detached sheet.
Complete slender-leg chair with a coherent rim and blue seat. Open space below raised back is plausible design; no obvious accidental crack in displayed surfaces.
Blue seat, framed back and supports appear coherent. Tiny RAW irregularities are no longer obvious; no clear detached/folded sheet or surface tear.
Full chair silhouette and blue seating surface preserved. No obvious crack or fragment visible in the two depth views and sections.
Complete chair and blue seat. Front-right seat apron contains an irregular folded-looking triangular patch rather than a smooth panel; fine rim breaks are unresolved.
Full slender-leg chair with blue seat and smoother front apron. Minor RAW edge discontinuities persist, without a clearly detached sheet.
Complete chair, blue seat and relatively clean front apron. Fine rim/section interruptions remain too small to classify confidently.
Chair body and blue seat remain. Front-right apron still has a conspicuous folded-looking triangular patch; its depth/intersection status is not certified.
Blue seat and complete chair retained. Front apron is comparatively smooth and no obvious crack or loose sheet is visible.
Full chair and blue seat remain with a clean-looking apron. A short underside gap is visible in front section but is not clearly resolved in the depth views.
